newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Ho Wah Genting changes Malaysian unit name.
newsitem.headline: Ho Wah Genting changes Malaysian unit name.

text.p: Ho Wah Genting International Ltd said on Wednesday it had changed the name of a wholly-owned subsidiary Horiguchi Engineering (Malaysia) Sdn Bhd to Ho Wah Genting Electric Sdn Bhd (HWGE).
It announced the change, which took effect on December 31, 1996, after a general meeting on Wednesday.
The company said in a statement it intended to use HWGE to invest in the new business of producing several varieties of light bulbs in Malaysia.
The meeting also approved the investment by another wholly-owned subsidiary, Ho Wah Genting Travel (Cambodia) Pte Ltd, of about US$3.5 million in the Sokhalay Hotel and Restaurant.
